propositions: The wire history processor's projection callable never executes its context-window check on first requests because the filter only descends into ModelResponse messages with failed outputs, causing oversized first requests to bypass validation entirely

An oversized first request currently surfaces as LLMUnavailableError (provider-outage semantics) after a failed provider call rather than raising ContextWindowExceededError before any call, violating the error's documented contract

The seam check must estimate request tokens from authoritative content (instructions and message parts) at 4 chars per token to remain compatible with enrich's window*2-char source bound, which at 4 chars/token estimates to window/2 tokens and passes the guard

The shared seam guard must raise fail-closed ContextWindowExceededError when estimated request tokens plus output reserve exceed the smallest viable candidate window, matching the error type's documented request-terms contract
Per-op bounds remain first-line limits with the seam as a backstop; no existing op-local bounds are removed or modified by this fix
